# MySpotify

> MySpotify (formerly Vinyl) is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0), unofficial Spotify desktop client for Windows and macOS built with native Go UI ([MyGo](https://github.com/egoist/mygo)) instead of Electron. Download size is under 10 MB, browsing RAM is ~190 MB (+~60 MB system DRM process during playback), and cold start to content takes 1–2 seconds.

## Key Facts

- **Category**: Lightweight native Spotify desktop client / music player (non-Electron)
- **Platforms**: Windows 10/11 (amd64, WebView2 Widevine), macOS Apple Silicon (arm64, WebKit FairPlay), experimental macOS Intel (amd64), experimental Linux amd64 (`.deb`/`.tar.gz`, Qt WebEngine)
- **Current Version**: v0.4.41
- **License**: AGPL-3.0
- **Languages**: Simplified Chinese (`zh-CN`), Traditional Chinese (`zh-TW` / `zh-Hant`), English (`en`), Italian (`it`)
- **Privacy**: Zero telemetry or analytics; session renewal cookies are encrypted locally with Windows DPAPI or macOS Keychain
- **DRM & Compliance**: Does not crack DRM (uses OS Widevine/FairPlay modules). Unofficial client using Spotify Web Player internal interfaces; violates Spotify ToS and carries account restriction risk.
